answer.reason: The verses only name Alphaeus as the father of James (and of Levi in MRK 2:14) in lists of the apostles or in passing, saying nothing of what he himself did or what happened to him.
doubts: MRK 2:14 names Levi the son of Alphaeus, who may or may not be the same Alphaeus as the father of James; the verses do not say so.
